profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Senior DBA | Available for full time W-2 Employment in the US
profile.summary: I am a full stack software developer with 17 years of experience including the last 3 years of leading sub-teams. Skilled in using technologies such as Java, PHP, Angular, Node.js and Perl. I had experience working with Japanese clients. I have experience with software development methodologies such as Waterfall, Agile/Scrum in different roles of developer, team lead, scrum master.

positions.title: Software Engineer, DBA
positions.description:
- Design and implement ETL workflows between various data sources such as SAP, SQL Server, Oracle database and data warehouse using ETL Tools, WebFOCUS and SQL.
- Develop an automate system to print lab samples barcode labels for multiple chemical manufacturing sites using Thermo Sample Manager LIMS VGL, ZPL, Window Services and Oracle PL/SQL.
- Develop interface to generate new lab testing samples from in-house software using IBI iWay ETL Tools, Oracle PL/SQL, XML, and Web services.
- Install, configure, and upgrade database servers
- Develop, implement, and test backup and recovery strategies for system databases
- Implement monitoring tools to track database performance, capacity, and system health
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET · SAP · SQL Server · Oracle Database

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
Driving the development cycle from design to deployment of new feature requests, as well as maintaining existing web applications
•	Design, develop and test efficient, scalable, responsive and browser web applications
•	Responsible for web applications architecture stack with PHP, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, jQuery, HTML, Bootstrap CSS
•	Analyze problems and new feature request requirements reported by business partners
•	Handle software design, development and testing tasks
•	Learn quickly and adapt to team environment, work in Agile methodology and various phases of the Software Development Life Cycle
•	Support and communicate with the business partners when new features and bug fixes are requested
•	Be well-versed with client-side and server-side technologies
•	Perform code reviews following the project standards
•	Build RESTful API services and integrations using oAuth authentication
•      Database Management & Maintenance: install and configure database, perform regular database maintenance tasks such as indexing, statistics updates, and storage optimization
•	Ability to multi-task and work independently
Technologies Used: PHP, CakePHP and Laravel, RESTful APIs, PHPUnit, jQuery/JavaScript, HTML, Bootstrap CSS, SAML, OAuth2, PostgreSQL, Docker, Jira, Git, AWS Services
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · CakePHP · Restful · PHPUnit · SAML 2.0 · Oauth2 · PostgreSQL · Docker · aws s2

positions.title: PHP Developer at Talech (U.S. Bank)
positions.description:
Took responsibility of the software artifacts produced adhering to U.S Bank standards to ensure minimal impact to the customer experience
•	Responsible for designing, developing, testing products using PHP/React.js frameworks.
•	Takes feedback from code review and apply changes to meet standards.
•	Conducts code reviews to provide guidance on compliance with development procedures.
•	Build, optimize, and utilize REST APIs
•	Accountable for ensuring all aspects of product development follow compliance and security best practices.
•	Takes full stack ownership by consistently writing production-ready and testable code.
•	Consistently creates optimal design adhering to architectural best practices; considers scalability, reliability and performance of systems/contexts affected when defining technical designs.
•	Accountable for ensuring all aspects of product development follow compliance and security best practices.
•	Exhibits relentless focus in software reliability engineering standards embedded into development standards.
Technologies Used: PHP, Laravel, PHPUnit, REST API, React.js, Jira, Git, AWS Services
positions.insights: Skills: Jira · React.js · Git · PHP · PHPUnit · Laravel · REST APIs

positions.title: Developer / Team Lead
positions.locationName: Helios Bldg, Quang Trung Software City, Tan Chanh Hiep Ward, District 12, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
positions.description:
Coordinated 6-person team in developing and delivering software development projects by communicating with clients to define project scope, requirements, and schedule.
•	Implemented functionalities for both backend and frontend integration of web application.
•	Created highly scalable RESTful APIs following to business requirements.
•	Built RESTful APIs document using Swagger while working with backend and frontend.
•	Handled system analysis and testing to determine root cause and develop solutions.
•	Handled tasks as database administrator for SQL server, Oracle, MySQL
•	Created functional design and technical documentation.
•	Developed large-scale complex application using Java Spring.
•	Wrote unit tests for backend and frontend using Junit, Mockito, Mocha, Jasmine, Jest.
•	Researched and implemented current trends in web application technology.
•	Contributed to all phases (requirement analysis, design, coding, testing…) of software development life cycle using Waterfall or Agile / Scrum methodologies.
•	Handle difficult bugs related to web security, performance issues.
•	Implemented training plan, technical training for new team members.
•	Created timelines and monitor progress to streamline development.
•	Designed and implemented IAM roles and policies for Dev, QA, built on AWS using EC2, Lambda, S3
Technologies Used: Java, Spring Boot, REST API, Angular / Typescript, Node.js, React.js, Jira, Redmine, Git, SVN, Tomcat, jQuery, Bootstrap, MongoDB, AWS Services, MS SQL Server
positions.insights: Skills: Mockito · Node.js · Angular · Jira · JUnit · React.js · Java · TypeScript · Spring Boot · Spring MVC · Jasmine Framework · REST APIs
